newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-South Africa recover after early setback.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-South Africa recover after early setback.

text.p: South African tailenders Pat Symcox and Fanie De Villiers staged a stirring fightback against rampant Indian spinners to resurrect their side's hopes in the first test on Thursday.
Coming together with South Africa reeling at 119 for seven, they put on 63 runs for the eighth wicket to lead the tourists to comparative safety at 202 for eight at close of play on the second day.

Earlier some fine bowling by Indian spinners Sunil Joshi, Anil Kumble and Narendra Hirwani and a couple of doubtful umpiring decisions had raised Indian hopes of bowling out South Africa for a paltry total.
But Symcox (32) and De Villiers (40 not out) had other ideas.
Left arm spinner Joshi claimed four wickets while leg-spinners Kumble and Hirwani took two each.
Earlier India, resuming at the overnight 215 for eight, were bowled out for 223 within half an hour of the start of play. Tendulkar top-scored with 42 while Azharuddin scored 35.
Donald claimed four for 37 for the visitors.
India 1st innings 223 all out. South Africa 202 for eight (Cullinan 43, De Villiers not out 40, Joshi 4-42).
